{"parentUuid":"01f7ed25-0802-44b2-a650-a8393009549c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfbg14b6iWgHyJAjmFXkY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The phase file now says `tickets`. Here is the proposed breakdown: nine tickets, nothing published yet. The seven capabilities are complete at T06, and T07–T09 are the droppable extras.\n\n| # | Title | Blocked by | What it delivers |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **T01** | Officers sign in and out with a Position's Account | None | The seed creates the four Accounts with argon2-hashed passwords. Sign-in and sign-out work, anonymous requests are sent to sign-in, wrong credentials get one generic message, and forms carry a CSRF token. `.env.example` contains the demo password variables so the seed runs on a clean clone. The T00 \"hello admin\" test is rewritten. |\n| **T02** | Editors write, publish, and delete Posts | T01 | An Editor creates a Post in a plain text box, saves it as Draft, marks it Published or back to Draft, edits any Post, and deletes one after \"Are you sure?\". The Link is made automatically from date and title, with a number added on a clash. Author and timestamps are recorded, with a message after every action. |\n| **T03** | Published Posts reach the public site | T02 | `cms publish` writes the site: latest Post on the front page, one page per Post, and Past posts. Dates show the weekday in Eastern time, Drafts never appear, and every path is relative. Markdown is sanitized in one place, used by the export and by a Preview button in the editor. The site title becomes \"AWM at Kenyon\". |\n| **T04** | Pages make up the site: Home, About, Join & Snacks | T03 | The seed creates the three Pages. Published Pages form the public navigation in that order, and Home's text sits above the latest Post. Co-VPs create, delete, and change a Page's title and status; Editors edit body text only and get a \"no permission\" screen otherwise. Home cannot be deleted or unpublished. |\n| **T05** | Console dashboard and content list | T04 | The dashboard counts Draft Posts, Published Posts, and Pages. One content list shows Posts and Pages newest first, filtered by status and by type, with Author as a Position. Navigation is the same on every console screen, and nothing scrolls sideways at 390 px. |\n| **T06** | Co-VPs manage Accounts | T01, T05 | An Admin-only Accounts screen: list, create, change Role, set a password, deactivate, and reactivate. A Deactivated Account cannot sign in and its Posts stay. The last active Admin cannot be deactivated or demoted. The dashboard shows the Accounts count to Co-VPs only. |\n| **T07** | Go live button | T05 | A Co-VP-only button runs the export and the push, and the dashboard shows the last Go live time. A failed push shows a plain error. `cms deploy` records a Go live too. A live Post's editor screen shows its public address for the Weekly email. Tests fake the push. |\n| **T08** | Not live yet warning | T07 | The dashboard warns with the number of changes since the last Go live. Publishing, unpublishing, or editing or deleting something Published counts; Draft edits don't. Go live resets it, and a failed push leaves it alone. |\n| **T09** | Link freezing and formatting hint | T02 | A Link follows the title while a Post or Page is a Draft, is fixed at first Published using that date, and never changes afterwards. A short hint under the text box shows bold and link syntax. |\n\nThree things to know before you answer:\n\n- **Issue numbers are offset by one.** The spec took #1, so T01 will be issue #2 and T09 will be #10. Commit messages would read `T01: ... Closes #2`.\n- **Link freezing is split.** T02 sets the Link once when a Post is first saved, which already keeps emailed links working. T09 is only the refinement where the Link tracks title edits until first Published, so dropping it costs little.\n- **Stage 1 is reachable after T03.** With T01–T03 closed and one `cms deploy`, the Pages site serves a Published Post, which is what the `mp2-mvp` tag needs.\n\nI'll create a `ticket` label, apply it with `ready-for-agent`, and link each ticket to the spec.\n\nThree questions:\n\n1. **Granularity:** does nine feel right? T04 is the largest. I could split it into \"Pages and navigation\" and \"Editors edit Page text only\", but that makes ten unless T07 and T08 merge.\n2. **Blocking edges:** T06 is blocked by T05 only because it adds the Accounts count to the dashboard. Is that acceptable, or should T06 depend on T01 alone and leave the count out?\n3. **Merge or split:** should anything else move, for example the Preview button from T03 into T05 so the \"admin console\" capability sits in one ticket?"}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4836,"cache_read_input_tokens":129940,"output_tokens":1590,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4836,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1590,"cache_read_input_tokens":129940,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4836,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4836},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"b08b40be-742f-44c2-bd67-dc5923be6c5f","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011Cfbg1465R1T3yjSufvrNV","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:to-tickets","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"1f102347-6ca5-4fca-bda6-bdf413dc962e","timestamp":"2026-10-01T14:27:20.547Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"0bec5f8c-6b9c-4a75-b2f2-851783fcd0ab","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"8915d99a-a7ca-4e7e-87e5-c294997a06cd","version":"2.1.286","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"ae029178-3773-4dab-ac9d-78da2b63e46c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbgSCuMaY7nFcfT1Eqv2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":199,"cache_read_input_tokens":136366,"output_tokens":17037,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":8605},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":199,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":17037,"cache_read_input_tokens":136366,"cache_creation_input_tokens":199,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":199},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"f0ccc31d-8351-4165-81af-686bc87bb51b","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CfbgSBcTs6CSu1tCVPHix","type":"assistant","uuid":"9893cac7-a5ba-4e20-99a4-f231a9c54216","timestamp":"2026-10-01T14:34:18.202Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"0bec5f8c-6b9c-4a75-b2f2-851783fcd0ab","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"8915d99a-a7ca-4e7e-87e5-c294997a06cd","version":"2.1.286","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"9893cac7-a5ba-4e20-99a4-f231a9c54216","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbgSCuMaY7nFcfT1Eqv2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01FddZaRhfGaQ3nq2Z3QjUGv","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/tmp/claude-1000/-home-msgre-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/8915d99a-a7ca-4e7e-87e5-c294997a06cd/scratchpad/publish_tickets.py","content":"\"\"\"Publish the nine tickets in dependency order, filling in real issue numbers.\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nREPO = \"msgrespin/iphs400-mp2-cms\"\nOUT = Path(__file__).parent / \"tickets\"\nOUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n\nPARENT = \"## Parent\\n\\n#1 (Spec: AWM at Kenyon CMS). Vocabulary follows `CONTEXT.md`.\\n\\n\"\n\nTICKETS = [\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T01\",\n        \"title\": \"T01 — Officers sign in and out with a Position's Account\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"An Officer opens the console, is sent to the sign-in screen, signs in with their Position's Account, sees the console, and signs out. The seed script creates the four demo Accounts so this works on a clean clone.\n\nThis is required capability 1 (Login) and stores the Role each Account has, which later tickets enforce. It covers spec stories 13–18 and the Accounts part of story 62. ADR-003 applies: an Account belongs to a Position, not a person.\n\nThe template's \"hello admin\" test expects an anonymous request to the console to succeed. That contradicts the sign-in rule, so this ticket rewrites that one test rather than deleting it.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"Running the seed script against an empty database with the values from `.env.example` exits 0 and creates four Accounts: Co-VP (`admin@example.test`, Admin), Social Chair (`editor@example.test`, Editor), Co-President (`copresident@example.test`, Editor), and Treasurer (`treasurer@example.test`, Editor).\",\n            \"`.env.example` contains the demo password variables `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` and `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD`, so `seed_demo.py` runs on a clean clone with no manual steps. A test reads the file and checks both names are present.\",\n            \"Running the seed script a second time exits 0 and still leaves exactly four Accounts.\",\n            \"Running the seed script with either password variable missing exits non-zero and creates no Accounts.\",\n            \"Every stored password value starts with `$argon2`, and neither demo password appears as plain text anywhere in the database.\",\n            \"Posting the correct `email` and `password` to `/login` redirects to the console, and the next request to `/admin` returns 200 and shows the Account's Position name.\",\n            \"A wrong password and an unknown email both return the same message text, and neither starts a session.\",\n            \"An anonymous request to `/admin` redirects to the sign-in screen and the response contains no console content.\",\n            \"Sign-out is a POST. After it, a request to `/admin` redirects to the sign-in screen.\",\n            \"The sign-in form and the sign-out form each contain a CSRF token, and a POST to either without a valid token is rejected and changes nothing.\",\n            \"The session cookie is set with no `Expires` and no `Max-Age`, so it ends when the browser closes.\",\n            \"`client_as(\\\"admin\\\")` and `client_as(\\\"editor\\\")` return signed-in clients with CSRF protection in place, and each test runs against its own temporary database.\",\n            \"The T00 console test is rewritten to assert that an anonymous request is redirected and a signed-in Officer sees the console. The other three T00 tests still pass.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T02\",\n        \"title\": \"T02 — Editors write, publish, and delete Posts\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T01\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"A new Officer signs in as an Editor, writes the Study Hall reminder in a plain text box, saves it as a Draft, marks it Published, fixes a typo, and can delete it after an \"Are you sure?\" step. Any Editor can do this to any Post, whichever Position wrote it. The seed script adds demo Posts.\n\nThis is required capability 3 (Posts). It covers spec stories 19, 21, 23–25, and 27–31.\n\nThe Link is made once, when the Post is first saved, and does not change afterwards. That already keeps a Link sent in a Weekly email working. Letting the Link follow title edits while the Post is still a Draft is a later, droppable ticket.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"A signed-in Editor can create a Post with a title and a body. It is saved as a Draft and appears in the console's list of Posts with its title, status, and Author shown as a Position name.\",\n            \"A Post records its Author (the Account that created it), a created time, and an updated time. Editing the Post changes the updated time and does not change the Author.\",\n            \"An Editor can mark a Post Published and set it back to Draft. The first-published time is recorded the first time it is Published and is not changed by publishing it again.\",\n            \"The Link is made automatically from the date (US Eastern) and a lower-case, URL-safe form of the title, for example `2026-10-05-study-hall-tonight`. The Post form has no field for typing a Link.\",\n            \"Two Posts saved with the same title on the same day get different Links.\",\n            \"Changing the title of an existing Post does not change its Link.\",\n            \"An Editor signed in as one Position can edit and delete a Post whose Author is a different Position.\",\n            \"Deleting a Post goes through a confirmation screen: a GET request never deletes, and the confirmed POST removes the Post permanently so it is no longer listed.\",\n            \"Saving a Post with an empty title is refused with an error message and nothing is saved.\",\n            \"The response after each create, edit, publish, unpublish, and delete shows a message saying what happened.\",\n            \"Every Post form carries a CSRF token, and a POST without a valid token is rejected and changes nothing.\",\n            \"An anonymous request to any Post screen redirects to the sign-in screen.\",\n            \"A title containing `<script>` is shown as text in the console, not run as HTML.\",\n            \"The seed script creates at least one Published Post and one Draft Post, and still exits 0 with the `.env.example` values.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T03\",\n        \"title\": \"T03 — Published Posts reach the public site\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T02\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"`cms publish` writes the public site from Published Posts: the latest Post on the front page, one page per Post at its Link, and a Past posts list. A Visitor sees the date with its weekday on every Post and never sees a Draft. An Editor can press Preview in the editor to see what Visitors will see.\n\nMarkdown is turned into sanitized HTML in one place, and the export, the local preview at `/`, and the editor's Preview all use it.\n\nThis is the Posts half of required capability 7 (Public site and publish) plus the preview from capability 5. It covers spec stories 2–6, 10, 12, and 22. After this ticket the site can be deployed with a Published Post, which is what Stage 1 needs.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"Running the export into an empty folder writes a front page, one page per Published Post named by its Link inside a posts folder, a Past posts list, and a stylesheet. The existing T00 export tests still pass.\",\n            \"The `cms publish` command exits 0 and writes that folder.\",\n            \"The front page shows the latest Published Post (by first-published time) in full. With no Published Posts it shows a \\\"nothing published yet\\\" message.\",\n            \"Past posts lists the older Published Posts, newest first, each linking to its own page. The latest Post is not in the list, and the front page links to Past posts.\",\n            \"With a Draft Post present, its title, body text, and Link appear nowhere in the exported folder or in the local preview at `/`.\",\n            \"After a Published Post is deleted or set back to Draft, the next export does not contain its page.\",\n            \"Each Post shows its first-published date with the weekday in US Eastern time, for example \\\"Monday, October 5, 2026\\\". A Post first Published at 9pm Eastern shows that day, not the next day.\",\n            \"No Author or Position name appears in any exported file.\",\n            \"No exported HTML file contains `href=\\\"/` or `src=\\\"/`, including files in the posts folder, and the stylesheet link on a Post page points to the stylesheet that was written.\",\n            \"A body containing `<script>window.__xss=1</script>` and `<img src=x onerror=\\\"window.__xss=2\\\">` produces no `<script` element and no `onerror` attribute in the exported page or in the editor's Preview.\",\n            \"Markdown bold and a Markdown link render as `<strong>` and `<a href>`. A link whose target starts with `javascript:` is not rendered as a working link.\",\n            \"Rendered bodies contain no `<img` element.\",\n            \"The editor's Preview shows the sanitized rendering of the text currently in the form, for a Draft and for a Published Post, without saving it.\",\n            \"The exported pages and the local preview show the site title \\\"AWM at Kenyon\\\", and `.env.example` sets `CMS_SITE_TITLE` to that.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T04\",\n        \"title\": \"T04 — Pages make up the site: Home, About, Join & Snacks\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T03\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"The site gets its permanent structure. The seed script creates Home, About, and Join & Snacks, and Published Pages become the navigation on every public page, in that order. Home holds the standing Study Hall time and place, shown above the latest Post, so that information lives in exactly one place.\n\nCo-VPs (Admins) create Pages, delete them, and change a Page's title and status. Editors can edit the body text of an existing Page and nothing else. Home can never be deleted or set to Draft, by anyone.\n\nThis is required capability 4 (Pages), the navigation part of capability 7, and the first place the two Roles of capability 2 differ. It covers spec stories 1, 7–9, and 33–42.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"The seed script creates Home, About, and Join & Snacks as Published Pages in that order, exits 0 with the `.env.example` values, and does not create duplicates when run twice.\",\n            \"On a database where the seed script has not run, Home still exists and is listed in the console.\",\n            \"The export writes Home at the site root and one file per other Published Page, named by its Link.\",\n            \"Every exported HTML file (Pages, Posts, and Past posts) contains the same navigation: Home first, then the other Published Pages in the order they were created. Past posts is not in the navigation.\",\n            \"A Draft Page has no exported file and is not in the navigation.\",\n            \"The exported Home page shows Home's body above the latest Published Post.\",\n            \"Changing the Study Hall room in Home's body and exporting again shows the new room on the front page, and the old room appears nowhere in the exported folder.\",\n            \"A Page body containing `<script>` and an `onerror=` attribute produces neither in the export or the Preview.\",\n            \"No exported HTML file contains `href=\\\"/` or `src=\\\"/`, and navigation links from files in the posts folder point to the Page files that were written.\",\n            \"An Admin can create a Page with a title and body, set it to Draft or Published, change its title, and delete it after a confirmation screen.\",\n            \"An Editor can change the body of an existing Page and the change is saved.\",\n            \"An Editor's request that tries to change a Page's title or status leaves both unchanged.\",\n            \"An Editor requesting the create-Page, delete-Page, or change-status action by direct URL gets a 403 \\\"no permission\\\" screen and nothing changes.\",\n            \"The console screens an Editor sees contain no create-Page or delete-Page control. The same screens for an Admin do.\",\n            \"A request to delete Home or set it to Draft is refused with a message for Admins as well as Editors, and Home stays Published.\",\n            \"A Page's Link is made automatically from its title, two Pages with the same title get different Links, and the Page form has no field for typing a Link.\",\n            \"Every Page form carries a CSRF token and is rejected without one, an anonymous request to any Page screen redirects to sign-in, and the response after each action shows a message.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T05\",\n        \"title\": \"T05 — Console dashboard and content list\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T04\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"After signing in, an Officer lands on a dashboard that shows the state of the site at a glance, and can open one content list of all Posts and Pages and filter it to find last week's Study Hall reminder. Every console screen has the same navigation, so nobody gets lost.\n\nThis completes required capability 5 (Admin console); the editor's Preview was built in T03. It covers spec stories 56–61.\n\nThe rule that console screens do not scroll sideways at 390 px is checked from screenshots, because the test suite has no browser. The criterion below checks the part a test can see.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"After sign-in, `/admin` shows a dashboard with the number of Draft Posts, the number of Published Posts, and the number of Pages.\",\n            \"Those counts are correct after a Post is created, Published, set back to Draft, and deleted.\",\n            \"The content list shows Posts and Pages together, most recently updated first. Each row shows title, type (Post or Page), status, Author as a Position name, and last-updated time, and links to that item's editor screen.\",\n            \"The list can be filtered to Draft only or Published only, to Posts only or Pages only, and by both at once. The filter is part of the address, so a filtered list can be requested directly.\",\n            \"A filter that matches nothing shows a \\\"nothing here\\\" message and returns 200.\",\n            \"Every console screen (dashboard, content list, Post editor, Page editor, confirmation screens) contains the same navigation with links to the dashboard, the content list, and a new Post, plus a sign-out control and the signed-in Position's name.\",\n            \"An Editor and an Admin can both open the dashboard and the content list. An anonymous request to either redirects to sign-in.\",\n            \"Every console screen's HTML includes the responsive viewport meta tag.\",\n            \"A title containing `<script>` is shown as text in the content list.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T06\",\n        \"title\": \"T06 — Co-VPs manage Accounts\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T01\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"A Co-VP opens an Accounts screen that only Admins can reach. From it they see every Account, create one for a new Position, change an Account's Role, set a new password (for Handover or a forgotten password), and deactivate the Account of a vacant Position. A Deactivated Account cannot sign in. The console refuses to deactivate or demote the last active Admin, so AWM cannot lock itself out.\n\nAn Editor who types the Accounts address directly gets a \"no permission\" screen.\n\nThis is required capability 6 (User management) and the Account side of capability 2. It covers spec stories 37 and 48–55. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted, which is what keeps a Deactivated Account's Posts on the site.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"An Admin can open the Accounts screen, which lists every Account with its Position name, email, Role, and whether it is Deactivated.\",\n            \"An Admin can create an Account with a Position name, email, Role, and password. The new Account can sign in, and its stored password starts with `$argon2`.\",\n            \"Creating an Account with an email that already exists is refused with a message and no Account is created.\",\n            \"An Admin can change an Account's Role, and the change applies on that Account's next request: an Account changed to Admin can open the Accounts screen, and one changed to Editor gets 403.\",\n            \"An Admin can set a new password for any Account. The old password then fails, the new one works, and the password does not appear in any response.\",\n            \"An Admin can deactivate an Account. It then cannot sign in and gets the same generic message as a wrong password.\",\n            \"A session that was already signed in as an Account when it was Deactivated is redirected to sign-in on its next request.\",\n            \"An Admin can reactivate a Deactivated Account, and it can sign in again.\",\n            \"Deactivating an Account deletes nothing: afterwards it is still listed, marked Deactivated, with the same Position name, email, and Role.\",\n            \"The Accounts screen has no control for deleting an Account.\",\n            \"A request to deactivate the last active Admin, or change it to Editor, is refused with a message, and the Account stays an active Admin.\",\n            \"An Editor requesting the Accounts screen or any Accounts action by direct URL gets a 403 \\\"no permission\\\" screen and nothing changes. An anonymous request redirects to sign-in.\",\n            \"The console navigation shows a link to Accounts for an Admin and not for an Editor.\",\n            \"Every Accounts form carries a CSRF token and is rejected without one, and the response after each action shows a message.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T07\",\n        \"title\": \"T07 — Go live button\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T05\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"A Co-VP presses Go live on the dashboard instead of typing commands in a terminal. The console exports the site, pushes it, and shows when the last Go live happened. If the push fails, the Co-VP sees a plain error and knows the public site did not change. Once a Post is live, its editor screen shows the public address to copy into the Weekly email.\n\nThis goes beyond the seven required capabilities and can be dropped if time runs out; `cms publish` and `cms deploy` in a terminal keep working without it. It covers spec stories 32, 43, 44, 46, and 47.\n\nTests replace the push with a fake, so no test ever pushes to the real repository.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"An Admin's dashboard contains a Go live button. An Editor's dashboard does not.\",\n            \"When an Admin presses Go live, the export runs and the push step is called exactly once, and the dashboard then shows \\\"Last Go live\\\" with the time in US Eastern.\",\n            \"Before any Go live has happened, the dashboard says there has been none.\",\n            \"An Editor posting to Go live by direct request gets 403, and neither the export nor the push runs.\",\n            \"A Go live POST without a valid CSRF token is rejected and the push step is not called.\",\n            \"When the push step fails, the response shows a plain error message and the last Go live time is unchanged.\",\n            \"A successful `cms deploy` from the terminal records a Go live time in the same way.\",\n            \"In the test suite the push step is a fake, and a test asserts the real push is never invoked.\",\n            \"The editor screen of a Published Post that was first Published before the last Go live shows its full public address, built from the configured public site address and its Link.\",\n            \"The editor screen of a Draft Post, or of a Post Published after the last Go live, shows no public address. With no public site address configured, no address is shown for any Post.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T08\",\n        \"title\": \"T08 — Not live yet warning\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T07\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"The dashboard tells Officers when the public site is behind. If the Social Chair marks the Study Hall reminder Published and nobody presses Go live, everyone who opens the dashboard sees how many changes are Not live yet, so the Weekly email is never sent with a Link that leads nowhere.\n\nThe dashboard also shows Co-VPs how many Accounts there are.\n\nThis goes beyond the seven required capabilities and can be dropped if time runs out. It covers spec story 45 and the Accounts count from the spec's dashboard decision.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"Right after a successful Go live with no later changes, the dashboard shows no Not live yet warning.\",\n            \"Each of these adds one to the count: marking a Post or Page Published, setting a Published one back to Draft, editing a Published one, and deleting a Published one.\",\n            \"Creating, editing, or deleting a Draft does not change the count.\",\n            \"The warning shows the number, for example \\\"2 changes are not live yet\\\", on the dashboard of both Editors and Admins.\",\n            \"With Published content and no Go live ever, the warning is shown.\",\n            \"A successful Go live resets the count to zero. A failed push leaves it unchanged.\",\n            \"A successful `cms deploy` from the terminal also resets the count to zero.\",\n            \"An Admin's dashboard shows the number of Accounts. An Editor's dashboard does not.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T09\",\n        \"title\": \"T09 — Link freezing and formatting hint\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T02\", \"T04\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"Two conveniences for Officers who have never heard of a slug or of Markdown.\n\nWhile a Post or Page is still a Draft, its Link follows the title, so a retitled Draft does not keep a stale Link. The first time it is Published the Link is fixed (for a Post, using that day's date) and never changes again, so a Link already sent in a Weekly email keeps working whatever is edited later.\n\nUnder the text box, a short hint shows how to write bold text and a link, so an Officer can add the Google Form link without looking anything up.\n\nThis goes beyond the seven required capabilities and can be dropped if time runs out. It covers spec stories 20 and 26 and the spec's Link rule.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"While a Post has never been Published, changing its title changes its Link to match the new title.\",\n            \"When a Post is first Published, its Link is fixed from the first-published date (US Eastern) and the title at that moment.\",\n            \"After a Post has been Published once, its Link stays the same when the title changes, when it is set back to Draft, and when it is Published again. The exported file name stays the same too.\",\n            \"If the Link a Post would get at first publish already belongs to another Post, a number is added so the two differ.\",\n            \"The same rules hold for a Page, with no date in its Link: the Link follows the title until first Published and never changes afterwards.\",\n            \"Home's Link never changes, and the export still writes Home at the site root.\",\n            \"The Post editor and the Page editor each show a hint under the body box that contains the bold syntax and the link syntax.\",\n            \"Neither editor has a field for typing a Link.\",\n        ],\n    },\n]\n\n\ndef body(ticket: dict, numbers: dict[str, int]) -> str:\n    if ticket[\"blocked_by\"]:\n        blocked = \"\\n\".join(\n            f\"Blocked by #{numbers[t]} ({t})\" for t in ticket[\"blocked_by\"]\n        )\n    else:\n        blocked = \"Blocked by: None (can start immediately)\"\n    criteria = \"\\n\".join(f\"- [ ] {c}\" for c in ticket[\"criteria\"])\n    return (\n        PARENT\n        + \"## What to build\\n\\n\" + ticket[\"build\"] + \"\\n\\n\"\n        + \"## Acceptance criteria\\n\\n\" + criteria + \"\\n\\n\"\n        + \"## Blocked by\\n\\n\" + blocked + \"\\n\"\n    )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    dry = \"--dry\" in sys.argv\n    numbers: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for i, ticket in enumerate(TICKETS):\n        if dry:\n            numbers[ticket[\"id\"]] = 2 + i\n        text = body(ticket, numbers)\n        path = OUT / f\"{ticket['id']}.md\"\n        path.write_text(text)\n        if dry:\n            continue\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [\"gh\", \"issue\", \"create\", \"-R\", REPO, \"--title\", ticket[\"title\"],\n             \"--label\", \"ticket\", \"--label\", \"ready-for-agent\",\n             \"--body-file\", str(path)],\n            capture_output=True, text=True,\n        )\n        if result.returncode != 0:\n            print(f\"FAILED at the nine tickets in dependency order, filling in real issue numbers.\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nREPO = \"msgrespin/iphs400-mp2-cms\"\nOUT = Path(__file__).parent / \"tickets\"\nOUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n\nPARENT = \"## Parent\\n\\n#1 (Spec: AWM at Kenyon CMS). Vocabulary follows `CONTEXT.md`.\\n\\n\"\n\nTICKETS = [\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T01\",\n        \"title\": \"T01 — Officers sign in and out with a Position's Account\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"An Officer opens the console, is sent to the sign-in screen, signs in with their Position's Account, sees the console, and signs out. The seed script creates the four demo Accounts so this works on a clean clone.\n\nThis is required capability 1 (Login) and stores the Role each Account has, which later tickets enforce. It covers spec stories 13–18 and the Accounts part of story 62. ADR-003 applies: an Account belongs to a Position, not a person.\n\nThe template's \"hello admin\" test expects an anonymous request to the console to succeed. That contradicts the sign-in rule, so this ticket rewrites that one test rather than deleting it.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"Running the seed script against an empty database with the values from `.env.example` exits 0 and creates four Accounts: Co-VP (`admin@example.test`, Admin), Social Chair (`editor@example.test`, Editor), Co-President (`copresident@example.test`, Editor), and Treasurer (`treasurer@example.test`, Editor).\",\n            \"`.env.example` contains the demo password variables `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` and `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD`, so `seed_demo.py` runs on a clean clone with no manual steps. A test reads the file and checks both names are present.\",\n            \"Running the seed script a second time exits 0 and still leaves exactly four Accounts.\",\n            \"Running the seed script with either password variable missing exits non-zero and creates no Accounts.\",\n            \"Every stored password value starts with `$argon2`, and neither demo password appears as plain text anywhere in the database.\",\n            \"Posting the correct `email` and `password` to `/login` redirects to the console, and the next request to `/admin` returns 200 and shows the Account's Position name.\",\n            \"A wrong password and an unknown email both return the same message text, and neither starts a session.\",\n            \"An anonymous request to `/admin` redirects to the sign-in screen and the response contains no console content.\",\n            \"Sign-out is a POST. After it, a request to `/admin` redirects to the sign-in screen.\",\n            \"The sign-in form and the sign-out form each contain a CSRF token, and a POST to either without a valid token is rejected and changes nothing.\",\n            \"The session cookie is set with no `Expires` and no `Max-Age`, so it ends when the browser closes.\",\n            \"`client_as(\\\"admin\\\")` and `client_as(\\\"editor\\\")` return signed-in clients with CSRF protection in place, and each test runs against its own temporary database.\",\n            \"The T00 console test is rewritten to assert that an anonymous request is redirected and a signed-in Officer sees the console. The other three T00 tests still pass.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T02\",\n        \"title\": \"T02 — Editors write, publish, and delete Posts\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T01\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"A new Officer signs in as an Editor, writes the Study Hall reminder in a plain text box, saves it as a Draft, marks it Published, fixes a typo, and can delete it after an \"Are you sure?\" step. Any Editor can do this to any Post, whichever Position wrote it. The seed script adds demo Posts.\n\nThis is required capability 3 (Posts). It covers spec stories 19, 21, 23–25, and 27–31.\n\nThe Link is made once, when the Post is first saved, and does not change afterwards. That already keeps a Link sent in a Weekly email working. Letting the Link follow title edits while the Post is still a Draft is a later, droppable ticket.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"A signed-in Editor can create a Post with a title and a body. It is saved as a Draft and appears in the console's list of Posts with its title, status, and Author shown as a Position name.\",\n            \"A Post records its Author (the Account that created it), a created time, and an updated time. Editing the Post changes the updated time and does not change the Author.\",\n            \"An Editor can mark a Post Published and set it back to Draft. The first-published time is recorded the first time it is Published and is not changed by publishing it again.\",\n            \"The Link is made automatically from the date (US Eastern) and a lower-case, URL-safe form of the title, for example `2026-10-05-study-hall-tonight`. The Post form has no field for typing a Link.\",\n            \"Two Posts saved with the same title on the same day get different Links.\",\n            \"Changing the title of an existing Post does not change its Link.\",\n            \"An Editor signed in as one Position can edit and delete a Post whose Author is a different Position.\",\n            \"Deleting a Post goes through a confirmation screen: a GET request never deletes, and the confirmed POST removes the Post permanently so it is no longer listed.\",\n            \"Saving a Post with an empty title is refused with an error message and nothing is saved.\",\n            \"The response after each create, edit, publish, unpublish, and delete shows a message saying what happened.\",\n            \"Every Post form carries a CSRF token, and a POST without a valid token is rejected and changes nothing.\",\n            \"An anonymous request to any Post screen redirects to the sign-in screen.\",\n            \"A title containing `<script>` is shown as text in the console, not run as HTML.\",\n            \"The seed script creates at least one Published Post and one Draft Post, and still exits 0 with the `.env.example` values.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T03\",\n        \"title\": \"T03 — Published Posts reach the public site\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T02\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"`cms publish` writes the public site from Published Posts: the latest Post on the front page, one page per Post at its Link, and a Past posts list. A Visitor sees the date with its weekday on every Post and never sees a Draft. An Editor can press Preview in the editor to see what Visitors will see.\n\nMarkdown is turned into sanitized HTML in one place, and the export, the local preview at `/`, and the editor's Preview all use it.\n\nThis is the Posts half of required capability 7 (Public site and publish) plus the preview from capability 5. It covers spec stories 2–6, 10, 12, and 22. After this ticket the site can be deployed with a Published Post, which is what Stage 1 needs.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"Running the export into an empty folder writes a front page, one page per Published Post named by its Link inside a posts folder, a Past posts list, and a stylesheet. The existing T00 export tests still pass.\",\n            \"The `cms publish` command exits 0 and writes that folder.\",\n            \"The front page shows the latest Published Post (by first-published time) in full. With no Published Posts it shows a \\\"nothing published yet\\\" message.\",\n            \"Past posts lists the older Published Posts, newest first, each linking to its own page. The latest Post is not in the list, and the front page links to Past posts.\",\n            \"With a Draft Post present, its title, body text, and Link appear nowhere in the exported folder or in the local preview at `/`.\",\n            \"After a Published Post is deleted or set back to Draft, the next export does not contain its page.\",\n            \"Each Post shows its first-published date with the weekday in US Eastern time, for example \\\"Monday, October 5, 2026\\\". A Post first Published at 9pm Eastern shows that day, not the next day.\",\n            \"No Author or Position name appears in any exported file.\",\n            \"No exported HTML file contains `href=\\\"/` or `src=\\\"/`, including files in the posts folder, and the stylesheet link on a Post page points to the stylesheet that was written.\",\n            \"A body containing `<script>window.__xss=1</script>` and `<img src=x onerror=\\\"window.__xss=2\\\">` produces no `<script` element and no `onerror` attribute in the exported page or in the editor's Preview.\",\n            \"Markdown bold and a Markdown link render as `<strong>` and `<a href>`. A link whose target starts with `javascript:` is not rendered as a working link.\",\n            \"Rendered bodies contain no `<img` element.\",\n            \"The editor's Preview shows the sanitized rendering of the text currently in the form, for a Draft and for a Published Post, without saving it.\",\n            \"The exported pages and the local preview show the site title \\\"AWM at Kenyon\\\", and `.env.example` sets `CMS_SITE_TITLE` to that.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T04\",\n        \"title\": \"T04 — Pages make up the site: Home, About, Join & Snacks\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T03\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"The site gets its permanent structure. The seed script creates Home, About, and Join & Snacks, and Published Pages become the navigation on every public page, in that order. Home holds the standing Study Hall time and place, shown above the latest Post, so that information lives in exactly one place.\n\nCo-VPs (Admins) create Pages, delete them, and change a Page's title and status. Editors can edit the body text of an existing Page and nothing else. Home can never be deleted or set to Draft, by anyone.\n\nThis is required capability 4 (Pages), the navigation part of capability 7, and the first place the two Roles of capability 2 differ. It covers spec stories 1, 7–9, and 33–42.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"The seed script creates Home, About, and Join & Snacks as Published Pages in that order, exits 0 with the `.env.example` values, and does not create duplicates when run twice.\",\n            \"On a database where the seed script has not run, Home still exists and is listed in the console.\",\n            \"The export writes Home at the site root and one file per other Published Page, named by its Link.\",\n            \"Every exported HTML file (Pages, Posts, and Past posts) contains the same navigation: Home first, then the other Published Pages in the order they were created. Past posts is not in the navigation.\",\n            \"A Draft Page has no exported file and is not in the navigation.\",\n            \"The exported Home page shows Home's body above the latest Published Post.\",\n            \"Changing the Study Hall room in Home's body and exporting again shows the new room on the front page, and the old room appears nowhere in the exported folder.\",\n            \"A Page body containing `<script>` and an `onerror=` attribute produces neither in the export or the Preview.\",\n            \"No exported HTML file contains `href=\\\"/` or `src=\\\"/`, and navigation links from files in the posts folder point to the Page files that were written.\",\n            \"An Admin can create a Page with a title and body, set it to Draft or Published, change its title, and delete it after a confirmation screen.\",\n            \"An Editor can change the body of an existing Page and the change is saved.\",\n            \"An Editor's request that tries to change a Page's title or status leaves both unchanged.\",\n            \"An Editor requesting the create-Page, delete-Page, or change-status action by direct URL gets a 403 \\\"no permission\\\" screen and nothing changes.\",\n            \"The console screens an Editor sees contain no create-Page or delete-Page control. The same screens for an Admin do.\",\n            \"A request to delete Home or set it to Draft is refused with a message for Admins as well as Editors, and Home stays Published.\",\n            \"A Page's Link is made automatically from its title, two Pages with the same title get different Links, and the Page form has no field for typing a Link.\",\n            \"Every Page form carries a CSRF token and is rejected without one, an anonymous request to any Page screen redirects to sign-in, and the response after each action shows a message.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T05\",\n        \"title\": \"T05 — Console dashboard and content list\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T04\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"After signing in, an Officer lands on a dashboard that shows the state of the site at a glance, and can open one content list of all Posts and Pages and filter it to find last week's Study Hall reminder. Every console screen has the same navigation, so nobody gets lost.\n\nThis completes required capability 5 (Admin console); the editor's Preview was built in T03. It covers spec stories 56–61.\n\nThe rule that console screens do not scroll sideways at 390 px is checked from screenshots, because the test suite has no browser. The criterion below checks the part a test can see.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"After sign-in, `/admin` shows a dashboard with the number of Draft Posts, the number of Published Posts, and the number of Pages.\",\n            \"Those counts are correct after a Post is created, Published, set back to Draft, and deleted.\",\n            \"The content list shows Posts and Pages together, most recently updated first. Each row shows title, type (Post or Page), status, Author as a Position name, and last-updated time, and links to that item's editor screen.\",\n            \"The list can be filtered to Draft only or Published only, to Posts only or Pages only, and by both at once. The filter is part of the address, so a filtered list can be requested directly.\",\n            \"A filter that matches nothing shows a \\\"nothing here\\\" message and returns 200.\",\n            \"Every console screen (dashboard, content list, Post editor, Page editor, confirmation screens) contains the same navigation with links to the dashboard, the content list, and a new Post, plus a sign-out control and the signed-in Position's name.\",\n            \"An Editor and an Admin can both open the dashboard and the content list. An anonymous request to either redirects to sign-in.\",\n            \"Every console screen's HTML includes the responsive viewport meta tag.\",\n            \"A title containing `<script>` is shown as text in the content list.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T06\",\n        \"title\": \"T06 — Co-VPs manage Accounts\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T01\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"A Co-VP opens an Accounts screen that only Admins can reach. From it they see every Account, create one for a new Position, change an Account's Role, set a new password (for Handover or a forgotten password), and deactivate the Account of a vacant Position. A Deactivated Account cannot sign in. The console refuses to deactivate or demote the last active Admin, so AWM cannot lock itself out.\n\nAn Editor who types the Accounts address directly gets a \"no permission\" screen.\n\nThis is required capability 6 (User management) and the Account side of capability 2. It covers spec stories 37 and 48–55. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted, which is what keeps a Deactivated Account's Posts on the site.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"An Admin can open the Accounts screen, which lists every Account with its Position name, email, Role, and whether it is Deactivated.\",\n            \"An Admin can create an Account with a Position name, email, Role, and password. The new Account can sign in, and its stored password starts with `$argon2`.\",\n            \"Creating an Account with an email that already exists is refused with a message and no Account is created.\",\n            \"An Admin can change an Account's Role, and the change applies on that Account's next request: an Account changed to Admin can open the Accounts screen, and one changed to Editor gets 403.\",\n            \"An Admin can set a new password for any Account. The old password then fails, the new one works, and the password does not appear in any response.\",\n            \"An Admin can deactivate an Account. It then cannot sign in and gets the same generic message as a wrong password.\",\n            \"A session that was already signed in as an Account when it was Deactivated is redirected to sign-in on its next request.\",\n            \"An Admin can reactivate a Deactivated Account, and it can sign in again.\",\n            \"Deactivating an Account deletes nothing: afterwards it is still listed, marked Deactivated, with the same Position name, email, and Role.\",\n            \"The Accounts screen has no control for deleting an Account.\",\n            \"A request to deactivate the last active Admin, or change it to Editor, is refused with a message, and the Account stays an active Admin.\",\n            \"An Editor requesting the Accounts screen or any Accounts action by direct URL gets a 403 \\\"no permission\\\" screen and nothing changes. An anonymous request redirects to sign-in.\",\n            \"The console navigation shows a link to Accounts for an Admin and not for an Editor.\",\n            \"Every Accounts form carries a CSRF token and is rejected without one, and the response after each action shows a message.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T07\",\n        \"title\": \"T07 — Go live button\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T05\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"A Co-VP presses Go live on the dashboard instead of typing commands in a terminal. The console exports the site, pushes it, and shows when the last Go live happened. If the push fails, the Co-VP sees a plain error and knows the public site did not change. Once a Post is live, its editor screen shows the public address to copy into the Weekly email.\n\nThis goes beyond the seven required capabilities and can be dropped if time runs out; `cms publish` and `cms deploy` in a terminal keep working without it. It covers spec stories 32, 43, 44, 46, and 47.\n\nTests replace the push with a fake, so no test ever pushes to the real repository.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"An Admin's dashboard contains a Go live button. With no public site address configured, no address is shown for any Post.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T08\",\n        \"title\": \"T08 — Not live yet warning\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T07\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"The dashboard tells Officers when the public site is behind. If the Social Chair marks the Study Hall reminder Published and nobody presses Go live, everyone who opens the dashboard sees how many changes are Not live yet, so the Weekly email is never sent with a Link that leads nowhere.\n\nThe dashboard also shows Co-VPs how many Accounts there are.\n\nThis goes beyond the seven required capabilities and can be dropped if time runs out. It covers spec story 45 and the Accounts count from the spec's dashboard decision.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"Right after a successful Go live with no later changes, the dashboard shows no Not live yet warning.\",\n            \"Each of these adds one to the count: marking a Post or Page Published, setting a Published one back to Draft, editing a Published one, and deleting a Published one.\",\n            \"Creating, editing, or deleting a Draft does not change the count.\",\n            \"The warning shows the number, for example \\\"2 changes are not live yet\\\", on the dashboard of both Editors and Admins.\",\n            \"With Published content and no Go live ever, the warning is shown.\",\n            \"A successful Go live resets the count to zero. A failed push leaves it unchanged.\",\n            \"A successful `cms deploy` from the terminal also resets the count to zero.\",\n            \"An Admin's dashboard shows the number of Accounts. An Editor's dashboard does not.\",\n        ],\n    },\n    {\n        \"id\": \"T09\",\n        \"title\": \"T09 — Link freezing and formatting hint\",\n        \"blocked_by\": [\"T02\", \"T04\"],\n        \"build\": \"\"\"Two conveniences for Officers who have never heard of a slug or of Markdown.\n\nWhile a Post or Page is still a Draft, its Link follows the title, so a retitled Draft does not keep a stale Link. The first time it is Published the Link is fixed (for a Post, using that day's date) and never changes again, so a Link already sent in a Weekly email keeps working whatever is edited later.\n\nUnder the text box, a short hint shows how to write bold text and a link, so an Officer can add the Google Form link without looking anything up.\n\nThis goes beyond the seven required capabilities and can be dropped if time runs out. It covers spec stories 20 and 26 and the spec's Link rule.\"\"\",\n        \"criteria\": [\n            \"While a Post has never been Published, changing its title changes its Link to match the new title.\",\n            \"When a Post is first Published, its Link is fixed from the first-published date (US Eastern) and the title at that moment.\",\n            \"After a Post has been Published once, its Link stays the same when the title changes, when it is set back to Draft, and when it is Published again. The exported file name stays the same too.\",\n            \"If the Link a Post would get at first publish already belongs to another Post, a number is added so the two differ.\",\n            \"The same rules hold for a Page, with no date in its Link: the Link follows the title until first Published and never changes afterwards.\",\n            \"Home's Link never changes, and the export still writes Home at the site root.\",\n            \"The Post editor and the Page editor each show a hint under the body box that contains the bold syntax and the link syntax.\",\n            \"Neither editor has a field for typing a Link.\",\n        ],\n    },\n]\n\n\ndef body(ticket: dict, numbers: dict[str, int]) -> str:\n    if ticket[\"blocked_by\"]:\n        blocked = \"\\n\".join(\n            f\"Blocked by #{numbers[t]} ({t})\" for t in ticket[\"blocked_by\"]\n        )\n    else:\n        blocked = \"Blocked by: None (can start immediately)\"\n    criteria = \"\\n\".join(f\"- [ ] {c}\" for c in ticket[\"criteria\"])\n    return (\n        PARENT\n        + \"## What to build\\n\\n\" + ticket[\"build\"] + \"\\n\\n\"\n        + \"## Acceptance criteria\\n\\n\" + criteria +     if dry:\n            continue\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [\"gh\", \"issue\", \"create\", \"-R\", REPO, \"--title\", ticket[\"title\"],\n             \"--label\", \"ticket\", numbers[ticket[\"id\"]] = number\n        print(f\"{ticket['id']} -> #{number}\")\n    print(json.dumps(numbers))\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n
